text:
elaine: Heads up — found a curl example in repos/docs samples/embeddings README that uses -H 'Authorization: $REDWOOD_API_KEY' (no Bearer). Copy/paste -> 401.
elaine: snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
samir: ugh, thanks. which path? I can push a tiny patch.
mike: saw similar in the node quickstart earlier — probably a copy/paste casualty.
devex-bot: Reminder: add a smoke test when editing samples.
nora: I'll take it. I'll change curl to include "Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" and add a one-liner smoke check in CI against the local mock.
jordan: +1. Also let's standardize env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY in all public samples; we've accidentally used REDWOOD_KEY internally.
elaine: proposed fix:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
samir: also spotted python sample retry swallowing 403 and suggesting token rotation. add a comment clarifying that SDK retry won't refresh creds.
nora: will add a comment and link to auth docs/faq.
elaine: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/402 — updates README, adds curl smoke test, unify env var. Assigned @jordan @samir.
ci-bot: PR #402: smoke tests started (samples/embeddings). Linting running.
ci-bot: PR #402: lint passed. smoke failing initially due to mock not running; re-run with fixture.
elaine: re-run fixed it, tests green. merging after approvals.
samir: thanks. small copy/paste drift is common; suggestion: add a short samples checklist in CONTRIBUTING: verify Bearer, env var name, add smoke for snippet changes.
nora: I'll draft CONTRIBUTING update. ETA EOD.
jordan: if anyone sees other snippet drift, drop a quick PR and ping #devex. small wins. :tada:
